'''Frellder''' was a high-ranked [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] serving during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He went missing on [[Tormin]], and the investigation revealed that Frellder's own men had [[Death/Legends|killed]] him due to his harsh style of command.<ref name="Missing">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Missing General}}</ref>
